items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I became a member of the 369th when I was sixteen, and that's when Lt. Simpson was commissioned to sign musicians to replace Jim Europe's band leaving.

ctx.x: I was fifteen. And I'm just talking and talking and talking -- When I played "Sister Kate," I was fifteen and a half, almost sixteen, 'cause I became a member of the 369th when I was sixteen, and that's when Lt. Simpson was commissioned to sign musicians to replace Jim Europe's band leaving.
Okay, let me get that straight. I'm a little confused about what actually is happening here. So, the bands at that time, like your church band, were they playing ragtime arrangements.
